problem_statement: Build a brand-new Pricing page from scratch at the /pricing route of this Material Tailwind dashboard. The route does not exist yet — today it falls through to the dashboard home. Construct the full static page inside the site's existing dashboard shell (left sidebar + top navbar + footer) and reuse the Material Tailwind design system (Card, CardHeader variant=gradient color=gray, Typography, Button, Chip, the blue-gray color tokens). The page presents a gradient page header and exactly three pricing plan cards — Starter, Pro and Enterprise — each with a price, a per-month cadence, a feature list and a call-to-action button; the Pro plan is flagged as the most popular. This is a static informational page with no interaction. It must also render without horizontal overflow on a 390px mobile viewport.
required_content: A gradient page header card titled 'Pricing Plans' with a large 'Simple, transparent pricing' heading, styled like the other dashboard card headers (gradient header, white title text)
Exactly three pricing plan cards laid out in a row: Starter, Pro and Enterprise
Each plan card shows a price and a 'per month' cadence label
Each plan card lists its included features with a check-mark icon per feature
Each plan card has a call-to-action button (Get Started / Start Free Trial / Contact Sales)
The Pro plan is visually marked as the recommended tier with a 'Most Popular' badge
The whole page sits inside the dashboard shell (left sidebar nav + top navbar + footer), consistent with the existing pages
The three plan headings must be exactly 'Starter', 'Pro' and 'Enterprise' (each rendered as a heading)
The three call-to-action buttons must include the labels 'Start Free Trial' (Starter), 'Get Started' (Pro) and 'Contact Sales' (Enterprise)
Each of the three plan cards shows a 'per month' cadence label under its price (three 'per month' labels total)
design_constraints: Reuse Material Tailwind components already used by the dashboard (Card, CardHeader variant=gradient color=gray, Typography, Button, Chip)
Keep the site's blue-gray color palette and spacing; do not introduce a new visual language
Mount the page inside the existing dashboard layout chrome (Sidenav, DashboardNavbar, Footer)
Static page — no client-side interaction required

Use the dashboard's blue-gray palette tokens: primary/heading text blue-gray #455A64 (rgb(69,90,100)) and #607D8B (rgb(96,125,139)), body text #546E7A (rgb(84,110,122)) and #263238 (rgb(38,50,56)), on a white (#FFFFFF) card background; the gradient page header uses the gray CardHeader gradient with white title text
Font family Roboto, sans-serif; headings bold (700), body regular (400); card corner radius 8px
Lay the three plan cards out in a single equal-width row on desktop (Starter, then Pro, then Enterprise), with the 'Most Popular' badge on the middle Pro card
author_notes: 方案A: baseline /pricing 是空 route (element={<></>}), 走不到 catch-all 重定向; reference 完整实现三卡定价页; bad 删除 Enterprise 套餐使 h3 'Enterprise' + button 'Contact Sales' 两个 dom_assertion 失败(页面仍渲染)。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。本 repo 无 basename/base, route 直接为 /pricing。T1 静态页无交互。
